verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a developer terminal for iOS with a local command set, so a Git or pull-request workflow is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions git, a GitHub CLI, or pull-request creation. Connecting to GitHub Codespaces or VS Code servers, or SSHing into a remote machine to run git there, relies on other platforms or user workarounds and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device
